# Dati undersampled

```{r soccer_field_probs_overs}
rm(list=ls())
load("../Dataset_ausiliari/dat_oversampled.Rdata")
load("../Dataset_ausiliari/dat_test.Rdata")
glimpse(dat_oversampled)
table(dat_oversampled$goal_YN)

glm_base <- glm(goal_YN ~ goal_distance + shot_angle_degree, family=binomial, data=dat_oversampled)
summary(glm_base)
exp(coef(glm_base))
prob_glm_base <- predict(glm_base, newdata=dat_test,
                         type="response")

anova(glm(goal_YN ~ 1, family=binomial, data=dat_oversampled), glm_base, test="Chisq")

x_pos <- cbind(matrix(seq(40, 0.1, length.out = 200), nrow=1), matrix(seq(0.1, 40, length.out = 200), nrow=1))
y_pos <- matrix(seq(120,0+1/10000, length.out = 800), ncol=1)

dist_pos <- outer(x_pos, y_pos, function(x,y) sqrt(x^2+y^2))
dist_pos <- matrix(dist_pos, ncol=400, byrow=T)

degree_pos <- outer(x_pos, y_pos, function(x,y) atan(y/x)*180/pi)
degree_pos <- matrix(degree_pos, ncol=400, byrow=T)

ris <- matrix(0, ncol=400, nrow=nrow(degree_pos))

for (i in 1:400){
  ris[,i] = predict(glm_base, newdata=data.frame(goal_distance=dist_pos[,i], shot_angle_degree=degree_pos[,i]), type="response")
}

library(ggsoccer)
colnames(ris) <- as.character(seq(0, 100, length.out=400))
rownames(ris) <- as.character(seq(0, 100, length.out = 800))

df <- data.frame(
  rown = rep(as.numeric(rownames(ris)), 400),
  coln = rep(as.numeric(colnames(ris)), each = 800),
  probabilità = as.vector(ris)
)

set.seed(123)
df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = rown, y = coln, fill = probabilità)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "D") +
  annotate_pitch(alpha=0) + 
  theme_pitch()
```
